wizard.title: Uninstall Wizard
wizard.confirmDesc: Ready to uninstall this application and run a deep leftover scan.

wizard.backupRegistry: Auto-export registry keys to .reg backup before deleting

wizard.rebootOnLock: Schedule locked files for automatic removal on reboot
wizard.waitingTree: Monitoring uninstaller process tree until all child processes exit.
wizard.scanningLeftovers: Scanning registry, AppData, shortcuts, and services...
wizard.noLeftoversDesc: No residual files, folders, shortcuts, or registry keys were detected.

force.desc: Force-clean stubborn software, broken entries, or any dropped executable, shortcut, or folder.
force.noLocks: No processes are currently locking these files.

batch.title: Batch Uninstall Queue
batch.desc: Uninstall selected applications sequentially and inspect leftover items together.

startup.title: Startup Manager
startup.subtitle: Manage programs launching with Windows (synced with Task Manager StartupApproved).

tracker.subtitle: Capture exact file and registry additions via fast pre/post system snapshots for 100% clean removal later.

tracker.activeHint: Complete your software installation now, then click Finish to capture exact additions.

backups.title: Backups & Operation Logs
backups.subtitle: Double-click any .reg backup file to restore deleted registry keys immediately.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure portable storage, safety policies, and appearance.

settings.showSystem: Show hidden system components by default
settings.showUpdates: Show Windows updates / hotfixes by default
